crossRefs.note: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
Now there was long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew…
Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

crossRefs.note: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
translations.bsb: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
translations.kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
translations.asv: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great host, like the host of God.
